rows.title: Owner-reported / missing evidence
rows.detail: Condition, prior attempts, quote date and preferences come from the owner. No photos, inspection report, model ID or quote documents were supplied.
rows.action: Unsupported factual cells remain blank. Do not infer the failed part or access feasibility.

rows.title: Unverified estimates
rows.detail: Three amount values were supplied in the brief but no provider-issued document or official price confirms them.
rows.action: Amount, quote-date and inclusion cells are blank. Scopes are labeled owner-reported; compare only after written like-for-like bids.

rows.title: No accepted combined scope
rows.detail: No company was contacted; availability, exact-job acceptance, combined plumbing/drywall price and schedule are unconfirmed.
rows.action: Shortlist is for screening only. Require one written scope naming all licensed performers.

rows.title: Review-platform limitation
rows.detail: Yelp profile fetches were blocked or available only through changing search excerpts. Review platforms are not government licensing sources.
rows.action: Numeric ratings/counts stay blank. Links are provided for current review discovery; no review excerpt proves this exact repair.

rows.title: Repository mismatch / duplicate drafts
rows.detail: The checkout mixes an unrelated DOE GEMS research project with several bathtub dossiers. Prior claims, counts and public routes differ.
rows.action: Preserve unrelated artifacts and Git history. Audit structure/provenance; do not claim scientific revalidation of the unrelated project. Root is canonical.

rows.title: Point-in-time license data
rows.detail: CSLB statuses can change and its database may lag.
rows.action: All license rows were checked 2026-11-07; recheck immediately before contracting.

rows.title: Unsupported prior assertions
rows.detail: Earlier drafts used phrases such as legally capable, same operator and exact-job experience beyond what the cited records establish.
rows.action: New tables distinguish license classification, advertised services, published job examples and unconfirmed acceptance.

rows.title: Workers-compensation exemption
rows.detail: Several records certify no employees and are exempt from workers-compensation insurance.
rows.action: Exemption is not evidence of general-liability insurance. Confirm actual crew and insurance certificates for every performer.

rows.title: Address / experience wording differences
rows.detail: Fast Response CSLB record spells the street W POTRAL AVE; earlier drafts normalized it. Website says 25+ years while the license was issued in 2017.
rows.action: Preserve official record wording; do not infer an address correction or equate license age with worker experience.

rows.title: Company-published job evidence / soft 404
rows.detail: Heise’s project articles render, but contain an embedded unrelated Page Not Found template. Job claims are self-published.
rows.action: Use the visible article/title as company evidence, flag the template irregularity, and request references. No drywall restoration or exact seized-part outcome is established.

rows.title: Minimum-job / commercial focus
rows.detail: Some B-licensed firms emphasize larger remodels, design-build or commercial projects.
rows.action: Do not assume they accept a small isolated repair; leave acceptance blank.

rows.title: Shared contact details are not ownership proof
rows.detail: Save-On-Interior #749536 and Bay Area Plumbing #757796 share address/phone in CSLB records.
rows.action: Earlier same-operator wording is not adopted. Confirm contracting entity and license usage in writing.

rows.title: Drywall partner is not a plumber
rows.detail: Bernal Hill Drywall holds C-9 + B, not C36.
rows.action: Use an appropriately licensed plumbing performer under the chosen contract structure.

rows.title: Official future-suspension warning
rows.detail: Advanced Plumbing and Drain #1009195 is active but carries an outstanding-final-liability additional status.
rows.action: Hold pending direct review of the official record; do not describe the warning as an actual suspension.

rows.title: B-2 scope not fully retrieved
rows.detail: HARP #1105133 is verified as B-2, but the classification page returned navigation only.
rows.action: Do not infer plumbing self-performance authority; require the appropriately licensed plumbing subcontractor.

rows.title: Out-of-city address of record
rows.detail: Several candidates have CSLB addresses outside San Francisco.
rows.action: Address is not service-area proof. Dispatch, travel charges and exact-job acceptance remain blank until confirmed.

rows.title: Complaint disclosure / license mapping
rows.detail: D G #297604 has official complaint disclosure. Cahill is #300647, not #297604.
rows.action: Review the official citation disclosure; do not use third-party license mappings.

rows.title: Suspended candidate
rows.detail: Kenneth Asire #1027286 shows contractor-bond suspension; bond cancellation date 08/16/2026 is displayed.
rows.action: Excluded from active shortlist. Reconsider only after official status changes and bond is verified.

rows.title: Unidentified license
rows.detail: Portola Plumbing Services appeared in a prior draft without a confirmed official license match.
rows.action: Identity/license fields remain blank; hold until an official record is established.

rows.title: Code-edition / interpretation limitation
rows.detail: The directly retrieved access-panel explanation is a 2018 UPC training spotlight and expressly not an official interpretation. Current local section text was not confirmed.
rows.action: Do not present 12 inches as a verified local determination for this tub. Ask the licensed contractor to identify applicable current requirements.

rows.title: Prior deployment diagnosis corrected
rows.detail: The latest legacy Pages run built successfully but its deploy job failed after about ten minutes. Earlier logs attributed failures to build-rate limits without sufficient evidence.
rows.action: Use an official GitHub Actions Pages workflow with explicit build gates and verify the deployed page content, not just a merge.

rows.title: No independent quality guarantee
rows.detail: License status, bonds, reviews and company project pages do not guarantee workmanship or fitness for this concealed repair.
rows.action: Use written scope, references, insurance checks and acceptance testing; flags remain visible after publication.
